name: Rhubarb
description: Sour red stalks stewed with sugar — the leaves are poisonous and never eaten.

tcm.note: Da huang is cold and strongly purgative in TCM; the culinary stalk is the mild end of a serious drug.

ayurveda.note: Revatchini is shita and laxative in the Ayurvedic record.

unani.note: Rewand is barid and a classical purgative.

histamine.note: Very sour and oxalate-rich; the oxalate is a separate hazard from histamine.
